'''Booton Piton''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], visited the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While walking in the district, the Human witnessed [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] [[Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder|airspeeder]] descending down into the district. Piton later visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] there, with the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Nardi Shodu]], on an errand.

==Biography==
[[File:NardiBooton-AOTC.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Booton Piton visited the Outlander Club on an errand.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] Booton Piton<ref name="SWI75" /> visited<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on the [[Local day/Legends|night]] of the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempted assassination]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]].<ref name="AOTC" /> While walking in the district, Piton turned around to watch Wesell's<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder|''Koro-2'' all-environment exodrive airspeeder]]<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> descend through the air. When the speeder crashed, Piton and<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Nardi Shodu]],<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|nardishodu|Shodu, Nardi}}</ref> approached the crash site.<ref name="AOTC" />

Shortly afterwards,<ref name="AOTC" /> Piton traveled on an errand with Shodu to the<ref name="SWI75" /> [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the district.<ref name="SWI75" /> They entered the club [[Limb/Legends|arm]] in arm just in front of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who were there to capture Wesell.<ref name="AOTC" /> Shodu and Piton then walked behind a<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> in the club and later spent [[Time/Legends|time]] with one another near a<ref name="AOTC" /> [[MixRMastR]] [[Droid/Legends|robot]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]].<ref name="FF57">{{FactFile|57|ROB 1-4|Robo-Bartenders}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Piton was a short,<ref name="SWI75" /> light-skinned<ref name="AOTC" /> woman.<ref name="SWI75" />

==Equipment==
During the Outlander visit,<ref name="AOTC" /> Piton wore a form-fitting hunters [[Clothing/Legends|cap]],<ref name="SWI75" /> a [[Color/Legends|gray]] coat, and white shoes.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Booton Piton first appeared in [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and in a picture in its [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (video game)|video game adaptation]].<ref name="AOTC" /><ref name="GBA">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' video game]]</ref> Both released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref><ref name="GBADate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2002/05/15/star-wars-episode-ii-attack-of-the-clones-3|text=Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones (GBA)|author=[https://www.ign.com/person/craig-ign Craig Harris]|date=2002-05-15|archivedate=20160325105351}}</ref> The Outlander Club scenes including Piton, who was portrayed by an uncredited extra, were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The extra playing Piton had to guide around the masked extra playing Shodu.<ref name="SWI75" /> Prior to the film's release, Dokes was first pictured in the documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]].<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> Piton was first identified in the web article "[[Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases]]," published on [[May 2]], [[2003]].<ref name="crc">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>
